summary: Minimum resilient mesh: two control nodes and two execution nodes, with peers=execution_nodes so every execution node is reachable from every control node; the capacity algorithm picks which control node runs a job.
questions: What is the minimum resilient automation mesh?
How is a control node chosen for a job?

answer_card.title: Minimum resilient mesh inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationcontroller]
aap_c_1.example.com
aap_c_2.example.com

[automationcontroller:vars]
node_type=control
peers=execution_nodes

[execution_nodes]
aap_e_1.example.com
aap_e_2.example.com
```
Control nodes peer with each other and with every execution node.
